title: A newborn miner a run left loaded docks at Confederacy Central Command, Sol and stores its hold
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 03:19 UTC (orders ENT-071, P6 and O1; rule F8). At 03:18 UTC newborn miners waited with 5 to 41 units aboard (iron, copper, starter goods): every gather of their rows asks an empty hold (fill.py status miner: hold not empty). The same work as store-hold-central-nexus for the Solarian-born rows, at their capital's station; requires.empire solarian keeps every other pilot off it.
